title: LLM-GLOBE: A Benchmark Evaluating the Cultural Values Embedded in LLM Output

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM outputs using the LLM-GLOBE benchmark, which employs both closed-ended Likert scale questions and open-ended generative prompts based on the GLOBE framework's nine dimensions of human cultural cognition. Open-ended responses are scored using an 'LLMs-as-a-Jury' automated evaluation protocol to measure and compare embedded cultural values between US and Chinese models.
